summary_en: FY2027 interim dividend set at 36 yen per share (21 yen ordinary + 15 yen special), up from 32 yen in FY2026. Ordinary dividend increased 23.5% to 21 yen; special dividend of 15 yen continues as planned through FY2029. Dividend payout ratio maintained above 50% based on net income.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Interim Dividend (Ordinary and Special) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Marusan Securities announced on 29 October 2026 that its board of directors approved an interim dividend for the fiscal year ending March 2027 of 36 yen per share, comprising 21 yen in ordinary dividend and 15 yen in special dividend, with an effective date of 1 December 2026. The ordinary dividend increases 23.5% from 17 yen in the previous interim period, while the special dividend remains flat at 15 yen as previously forecast. Total dividend amount is 2,392 million yen.

The company maintains its ordinary dividend policy of stable profit distributions above 50% payout ratio based on net income, while strengthening internal reserves to enhance corporate structure. The special dividend of 15 yen per interim and year-end period (30 yen annually) will continue through the fiscal year ending March 2029, as previously announced in September 2023 and July 2026. Year-end dividend for FY2027 remains undecided pending results.

The company stated that these enhanced shareholder return measures, combined with improving revenue structure, aim to realize its medium-term management plan target of 8% ROE for the five-year period through fiscal 2029.
